research.tip: Run the SAFE‑MED checklist (Source, Approved name, Evidence, Explain side‑effects, Medication plan, Discuss alternatives) before accepting any prescription.

data.title: Psychiatric medicines ke myths aur facts: kyun kam use hoti hain
data.title_en: Psychiatric medicines myths and facts: why they’re under‑used
data.hook_text: Side‑effects ka darr tumhe dawa lene se rok raha hai? Ek aisa myth hai jo sabko hairaan kar dega – aage dekho!

scenes.text: Riya, ek engineering student, sochti hai ki psychiatric medicines sirf severe cases ke liye hain – kya yeh sach hai?
scenes.text_en: Riya, an engineering student, wonders if psychiatric medicines are only for severe cases – is that true?

scenes.text: Bahut log side‑effects ki darr se dawa nahi lete, aur yeh darr unke liye bahut badi pareshani ban jata hai.
scenes.text_en: Many people avoid medication because fear of side‑effects becomes a huge worry for them.

scenes.text: Myth: Sab antipsychotics weight gain karvate hain.
scenes.text_en: Myth: All antipsychotics cause weight gain.

scenes.text: Fact: Kuch newer drugs jaise aripiprazole kam metabolic risk rakhte hain.
scenes.text_en: Fact: Some newer drugs like aripiprazole have lower metabolic risk.

scenes.text: Myth: Psychiatric medicines lene se aap lazy ya unproductive ho jaate hain.
scenes.text_en: Myth: Taking psychiatric medicines makes you lazy or unproductive.

scenes.text: Fact: Sahi medication aapki functioning aur productivity ko improve kar sakti hai.
scenes.text_en: Fact: Proper medication can improve your functioning and productivity.

scenes.text: Ab SAFE‑MED checklist se prescription ko smartly check karo – pehle authenticity aur approval dekho.
scenes.text_en: Now use the SAFE‑MED checklist to smartly check prescriptions – first look at authenticity and approval.

scenes.text: Phir, research evidence dekho aur doctor se side‑effects ke baare mein poochho.
scenes.text_en: Next, review research evidence and ask the doctor clearly about side‑effects.

scenes.text: Akhir mein, dose aur duration likho aur agar zaroori ho to dusri options bhi explore karo.
scenes.text_en: Finally, write down dose and duration and explore other options if needed.

scenes.text: Aaj se SAFE‑MED use karo, informed decision lo.
scenes.text_en: From today, use SAFE‑MED and make an informed decision.

scenes.text: Apni mental health ko priority do – agar doubts ho to trusted professional se baat karo.
scenes.text_en: Prioritize your mental health – if in doubt, talk to a trusted professional.

data.description: A short reel busting myths about psychiatric medicines and teaching the SAFE‑MED checklist so viewers can make informed choices.

fixes: Add a relatable Indian student/professional example to increase specificity
Include a stronger pain point in the hook about side‑effect fear
Condense the SAFE‑MED checklist into fewer, punchier scenes to improve pacing
Add a teaser in scene 2 hinting at a surprising myth that will be debunked later
